mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, increasing present value of future cash flows and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window or the average 5-day return in the lowest 25% of FEDFUNDS levels is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of nonfarm payrolls indicates strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window or the average 60-day return in the highest 25% of PAYEMS levels is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1.9 million units per month signals robust residential construction, driving consumer spending growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when HOUST > 1.9 (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 115.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, signaling economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 115.0 (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales signals strong consumer demand, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for HOUST*RSAFS < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window or average 20-day return when both series are above 50th percentile is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 195), a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%) signals aggressive monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 195 and FEDFUNDS > 2.5 (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC for joint condition < -0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production level indicates strong manufacturing output, supporting corporate profit growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window or average 20-day return in highest 25% INDPRO levels not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate above 5.5% signals labor market weakness, reducing consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 5.5 (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
